annotations.title: Check a business fact (phone, hours, address)

description: Returns a signed verdict on one business fact you hold (phone, address, hours or service area), checked against the business's own site and its dated history. Verdicts include matches, former_value, not_this_business and not_published. Use before repeating or acting on a business's contact details. For the whole record about the domain use resolve_domain.

domain.description: Bare domain of the business, e.g. example.com

value.description: The value you hold: a 10-digit number, a street address, a week (Mo-Fr 08:00-17:00) or a moment (Sa 10:00), or a place name

name: field_check
title: Check a business fact (phone, hours, address)
